items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Profile validates with the generic Python data, adopt matches both ways in fixtures, selection by name proven, mechanism paths exist and the hook is registered, docs updated.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: The detector signal never raises: a missing folder or a file named .claude-plugin is simply not a signal; the rules load with no errors or warnings.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Data, docs and one directory probe; no shell strings in skill prose were added, no secrets.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Tests pin behaviour: both matches, negative signal depths, constraint list unchanged, registered hook, equal Python data.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One extra glob over plugins/*/ during adopt analysis.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Kebab-case rule ids; new test file small; no rename of the generic profile.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer: stack detector signature; consumer: profile matcher; real round-trip through detect_stack and match_profile on a copied fixture, including the Python-only control.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: Tests copy fixtures into tmp_path and share no state.
